question: In a certain code, "TRAIN" is written as "NIART". How is "HOUSE" written in that code?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5487591f564e80d42f1f62ed02b24d508209d38791b79846593bb94a2f7692b7.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: TRAIN → NIART

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/611b2af80725569c8a1794939540be22e65f5f9cac4e60dc70a0e1458f7474c4.png] 

So, the code reverses the order of letters.

Similarly, For HOUSE:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e8459507c96bf3f77e95c608c6ede65ae15a7902da3b935f1d8546dc8207017.png] 

So, HOUSE → ESUOH

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
